name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Türkiye's prison sentence against journalist Bülent Mumay and calls on Turkish authorities to drop the charges against him and other detained journalists. It says press freedom in Türkiye is getting worse through laws and court pressure on critical voices. It asks the EU's diplomatic service to watch his trial and raise his case with Turkish officials. The text is a statement of concern and demands; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament demands Türkiye drop charges against jailed journalists.
- It affects Bülent Mumay, other detained media workers, and Türkiye's judiciary.
- Next: EU diplomats monitor trials and raise these cases with Türkiye.
